scientific_basis: The half-integral fixed point gives an explicit section of E to its signed permutation quotient. Every translation difference has even coordinate sum; the section survives every sD quotient.
For odd s, D/sD maps equivariantly to three cyclic factors: parity supplies surjectivity, and oddness identifies the kernel. CRT is an equivariant decomposition for s=6.
The s=4 normal subgroup is proved extraspecial by equality of centre, derived and Frattini subgroups, together with its order. Its actual S4 complement is checked rather than inferred from order.

The square origin stabilizer is a subgroup with faithful 48-root action and full linear-image order1152. This proves one splitting before reduction by any period lattice; the uniform claim does not rely on sampled s.
The finite46080 group is handled at the exact iterated extension stages; an unwarranted global complement to its innermost elementary kernel is not assumed.
Each named group is identified by a bijective homomorphism; every split stage checks normality, intersection, generation and the induced quotient map. Direct factors also commute.
